name: OpenRouter
tagline: One API for hundreds of models
description: OpenRouter provides an OpenAI-compatible API that gives access to 500+ models from 80+ providers. Model usage is billed per token at each provider's list price.
features: Prompt caching and management API keys
EU and US in-region routing (Business and Enterprise)
useCases: Trying many models behind one API
strengths: No platform fee on the Free plan
Free models available, with higher daily limits after buying at least $10 of credits
limitations: A 5.5% (Standard) or 8% (Business) fee applies when you buy credits
Free models are capped at 20 requests per minute and 50 per day until you buy credits
Per-model prices are not listed on the pricing page

plans.name: Standard (pay-as-you-go)
plans.note: No minimums. A 5.5% fee applies when credits are purchased, not per request

plans.name: Enterprise
highlights: Private endpoints available as an add-on

free.details: No platform fee; 25+ free models and 4 free providers; 5 workspaces; 50 requests per day (1,000 per day after buying at least $10 of credits); free models capped at 20 requests per minute.

api.summary: Model usage is billed per token at each provider's list price on every plan. Per-model prices are available from the models API rather than the pricing page. Standard and Business include $25,000 per month of list-price inference with no fee when you bring your own keys, then 5%.

pricing.regional: Prices are exclusive of applicable taxes; VAT or GST may be added on invoices. EU and US in-region routing is available on Business and Enterprise.
